name: RobotExpressive
notes: Rigged + animated humanoid robot by Tomás Laulhé (modified by Don McCurdy), shipped with three.js. Great for an autonomous ground unit; has walk/run/idle animation clips.

name: Xbot
notes: Rigged animated character robot from three.js examples. Alternate humanoid bot for the fleet.

name: Ferrari
notes: Detailed car body. Usable as a fast wheeled ground vehicle / chase unit if a sleeker rover is wanted.

name: Rover
notes: Low-poly wheeled rover by Quaternius via poly.pizza. Ideal autonomous ground robot. Direct file: https://static.poly.pizza/7992e6b4-8add-45a9-86fd-f208237d293c.glb

name: Round Rover
notes: Second low-poly rover variant by Quaternius via poly.pizza. Direct file: https://static.poly.pizza/d2dd449f-dd0b-440f-9c62-bfa7e6039a43.glb

name: Quadcopter Drone
notes: Quad-rotor remote drone with underside camera by NateGazzard via poly.pizza. CC-BY: requires attribution to NateGazzard. Direct file: https://static.poly.pizza/4eb88feb-cb2d-46c3-980d-3e704868361c.glb

name: Tree
notes: Low-poly tree by Quaternius via poly.pizza. For scattering across terrain. Direct file: https://static.poly.pizza/18bfa206-01b3-4368-a391-513f21078bb1.glb
